description: `x-formspec-class-scope: {}` — key present, nothing declared. Both layers refuse it: key presence alone is declared intent whose content cannot be read, and undeclarable intent fails closed.
note: Both layers agree, and the agreement is the design record. Evaluation used to read `{}` as not-configured (a key-counting presence test), so branch-open never fired `class-scope-deferred` and fell back to binary `allowedActors[]` admission — the silent skip. ADR 0152 §5.1 replaces that read: `{}` is `posture-config-invalid` at the gate as well as at the schema. Its sibling `valid-class-scope-null-explicit-no-config` draws the other half of the line — `null` is declared absence, admitted by both layers, because there is nothing to enforce and nothing that can fail open. Deployments meaning 'no class scope' omit the key or declare null.
